how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Just a few steps and you are at the forum you want

1.title: Choose a forum
1.text: Find an event you are interested in in the forum catalogue.

2.title: Get your ticket
2.text: Choose a category and fill in your registration details.

3.title: Pay online
3.text: Pay securely by bank card or other convenient methods.

4.title: Get your QR code and attend
4.text: The ticket arrives in Telegram and in your account. Show the QR code at the entrance.

about.title: About FORUM.KG
about.text: FORUM.KG is a modern platform for running forums and managing tickets in Kyrgyzstan. We help organizers publish events, sell admission tickets, verify payments, issue unique QR tickets and control attendee entry.

telegram.title: Telegram delivery
telegram.text: Tickets and notifications straight to your messenger
